## Z-Image Turbo API

Z-Image Turbo is an image generation model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `z-image-turbo`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Z-Image Turbo is the distilled, fast version of Z-Image, an open-weight text-to-image model from Alibaba's Tongyi Lab. It produces high-quality images in a few steps, which makes it a good default for quick generation.

### Z-Image Turbo API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `z-image-turbo` | Generate | Private | $0.01 / image |

### Z-Image Turbo specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Dec 3, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Prompt limit | 7,500 characters |

### How to use the Z-Image Turbo API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "z-image-turbo"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "z-image-turbo",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette"
  }'
```
